Yet each of the four walls bears a scarred, crumbling patch where the masonry looks thin and badly set, as though the builders meant it to be bombed open. Grit sifts from the cracks whenever the lake presses against the foundations, and the air is stale.

L4:C7.name: Knight's Approach
L4:C7.description: Polished floor tiles are scored with long scrapes where armoured feet drag across them on patrol, and a dented blue shield leans against one wall. A massive shutter fills the east doorway, and a hiss and a reek of sulphur seep around its edges from the lair beyond. The west wall is cracked and weak, and an open way leads north.

L4:D7.name: Hall of the Twin Necks
L4:D7.description: A vast hall of scorched stone opens beneath a ceiling blackened by fire. Twin fans of soot spread from the north wall where two long dragon necks reared and spat flame, and deep bite marks scar the floor where a severed head went on flying by itself. Lake water hisses in a gutter along the wall. A shutter closes the west door, and the door north is locked, coiled serpents around its keyhole.

L4:A8.name: Serpent Hearth Cell
L4:A8.description: Lake damp follows you even here, glazing the walls and dripping from a coiled serpent carved over the lintel, yet the fires at the far end burn steady and dry the air around them to a warm haze. Their light shivers on a thin sheet of water that runs down the back wall like a curtain. The stone between the braziers is worn smooth. The only door, a shutter, lies south.

L4:B8.name: Rafter Roost
L4:B8.description: Rotting timber rafters cross the low ceiling of this narrow room, and droppings crust the floor beneath them where bats crowd in the dark. The south wall sags around a breach of loose, crumbling brick that looks ready to give to a bomb. To the east an open doorway leads on.

L4:C8.name: Gauntlet of Blades
L4:C8.description: Square recesses sit in the corners of this chamber, and deep grooves run from them along the walls and across the floor where spiked blades slide at speed toward anything in their line. The stone is chipped bright along those tracks, and the safest path is the one the blades cannot see. Open doorways lead west and south.

L4:D8.name: Sanctum of Bowed Serpents
L4:D8.description: Pale stone glows here with a warm golden light that seems to rise from the floor itself. The endless drip of the lake falls silent, and carved serpents on the walls bow their heads toward an iron-banded chest, locked and waiting. Above it hangs a triangle of light, the way home for the one who opened the door. The door south, back to the scorched lair, is locked with the Snake's key.

L4:cellar:C5.name: Seeping Red-Brick Cellar
L4:cellar:C5.description: Beneath the sunken block a ladder drops into a cramped basement of red brick. Narrow ledges step across a dark floor where water gurgles in the gaps, and the low ceiling sweats with lake seepage that has left pale tide lines on every course. A little hoard of rupees has been wedged on a ledge out of the wet. The only way out is back up the ladder.

L5:C1.name: Lizard's Gate
L5:C1.description: The entry hall of the Lizard lies deep beneath the Lost Hills, its grey stone pillars carved with long-tailed lizards climbing toward the ceiling. The air is dry and dusty and tastes of old tombs and embalming resin. Doorways open north and east, and the stair behind climbs back to the windswept hills.

L5:D1.name: Echoing Chamber
L5:D1.description: Sound behaves strangely here: footsteps return from the walls doubled and distorted, and even a whisper hums back, and the long-eared things that hop about this room are said to hate a loud noise above all. Small round prints pock the dust. The north wall is cracked and weak-looking, and the west way leads back to the gate.

L5:A2.name: Western Stairwell
L5:A2.description: A dim, close room at the western edge of the labyrinth, its floor glazed with dried trails of slime that split and wander. In one corner a narrow stair plunges into darkness, running far beneath the halls toward the north. The east wall bears a sagging, crumbled patch of masonry where a bomb has been or will be.

L5:B2.name: Hall of Linen Biers
L5:B2.description: Stone biers line the walls of this chamber, every one empty, and scraps of yellowed linen lie trampled across the floor in slow, shuffling paths. The air is heavy with the sweet, dusty smell of embalming resin, and stone lids lean askew against the biers as though pushed from inside. A shutter seals the north door, and both the east and west walls show cracked, weak patches.

L5:C2.name: Embalmers' Hall
L5:C2.description: Long stone tables stained dark with old oils stand in the middle of this cross-shaped hall. Strips of grave cloth trail from them across the floor in shuffling paths, and the dark is thick enough to want a candle. A shutter guards the north, the west wall is cracked and thin, and open doors lead east and south.

L5:D2.name: Grey Brick Fireside
L5:D2.description: Grey brick walls curve gently inward here, and every sound rings back a moment late, as if the room were listening. Two small fires flicker beside a worn patch near the north wall, painting the brick orange and drawing a faint, reedy whistle from the draught that feeds them. Lizard heads are carved along the skirting. A cracked section of the south wall looks weak, and the west way stands open.

L5:B3.name: Slime-Glazed Vault
L5:B3.description: The floor of this chamber gleams with a thin glaze of green slime that pools around the blocks set in its corners, and some of the pools are thick enough to quiver. Every step makes a wet, sucking sound, and the walls drip with the same ooze. Heavy shutters stand in the east and south doorways.

L5:C3.name: Hall of Heavy Tracks
L5:C3.description: Deep three-toed tracks crush the dust of this broad hall, and the air carries a faint smell of smoke and scorched hide where bombs have been fed to something that swallows them. Shutters guard the west and south doors and a locked door bars the north, its iron keyhole rimmed with soot. An open way leads east.

L5:D3.name: Gray Junction
L5:D3.description: Mineral water drips from a fissure in the ceiling and spreads across the floor in long, shining trails that mingle with slime. A row of weathered blocks leans against the east wall, and a stone lizard grins down from above the north door with its tongue out. Open ways lead north and west.

L5:C4.name: Hushed Archive
L5:C4.description: This silent chamber is lined with niches holding crumbling clay tablets etched with lizard glyphs, and one wall is scratched with the outline of the whole dungeon, a crouching lizard drawn in rooms. Dust lies thick and undisturbed over everything. A locked door stands in the south wall and an open way leads east.

L5:D4.name: Shuffling Passage
L5:D4.description: A long vaulted passage runs between rows of blocks, with scraps of linen caught on their corners like flags, and the floor is worn into a groove by slow, dragging feet. A cold draught moves through it smelling of the grave and of dry resin. Open doorways lead north, south and west.

L5:A5.name: Sealed Crypt
L5:A5.description: A low crypt lies at the bottom of the western halls, reached only from the north where a heavy shutter hangs. Sarcophagus lids lean against the walls, pried open from the inside, and dust and linen threads float in the still, dark air. Whatever was wrapped and buried here did not stay that way.

L5:D5.name: Lizard Shrine
L5:D5.description: A carved lizard of green stone coils on a pedestal against the east wall of this small shrine, its eyes worn blank by time and its snout pointing always toward the dungeon's den. Faint slime trails wander across the floor around it, glinting in the gloom. Doorways lead north and south.

L5:A6.name: Digdogger's Den
L5:A6.description: The floor of this chamber is churned and dented as if a great spiked ball had bounced across it a thousand times, and broken spines lie scattered about. A low throb hums through the stone that falters at any shrill note. A locked door lies east, a shutter closes the south, and the door north is locked with the guardian's key.

L5:B6.name: Whispering Gallery
L5:B6.description: Curved walls of polished stone carry every sound around this gallery and back again, until a single footstep becomes a chorus, and tufts of pale fur from long-eared, hopping things cling to every edge. The north wall shows a web of fine cracks around one thin section. A locked door bars the west, and the east stands open.

L5:C6.name: Ossuary
L5:C6.description: Bones are stacked in neat niches from floor to ceiling, and a trodden path of linen scraps crosses between them where the wrapped dead walk their rounds. The air is cold and smells of dust and resin. A locked door with a heavy keyhole stands to the east, and the way west is open.

L5:D6.name: Bat-Haunted Tomb
L5:D6.description: Coffins of carved stone stand in two rows across this tomb, their lids spattered with bat droppings. The rustle of wings echoes from the shadowed ceiling, and torn wrappings trail from one cracked casket toward the door, as though its occupant got up and left. A locked door stands in the west wall, and the south is open.

L5:A7.name: Sanctum of Turning Lizards
L5:A7.description: Lizards carved in pale grey stone line this quiet sanctum above the battered den, every one turning its head toward an iron-banded chest locked in the middle of the floor. Golden light gathers in the still air, warm after the cold of the tombs, and gathers tightest in a turning triangle of light that offers the way home. The door south is locked with the guardian's key.

L5:B7.name: Nook Behind the False Wall
L5:B7.description: This narrow room was walled off long ago, and the air still tastes of old dust and lamp smoke. Twin fires burn in shallow stone bowls, and between them the floor is polished by long standing. A row of notches scored along one wall looks like a set of old target marks, every one struck dead centre. The only way out is the south wall, a cracked and weak-looking stretch with chips of mortar scattered at its foot.

L5:C7.name: Rafter Hall
L5:C7.description: Rotting beams cross the ceiling of this hall, white with the droppings of the bats that roost there and dart down in jittering flights. The east wall bulges around a cracked, weak-looking section of brick. To the north a locked door bars the way, and leathery wingbeats echo overhead.

L5:D7.name: Bomb Seller's Back Room
L5:D7.description: Behind the weak stone of the west wall lies a snug room, its corners stacked with empty crates that smell of saltpetre and lamp oil. Fires crackle on either side of a worn spot by the north wall, and before them, on a squat stone block, a fat canvas bomb bag is displayed with a price of 100 rupees painted beside it. The only exit is the cracked, weak-looking section of the west wall.

L5:B8.name: Room of the Scraped Block
L5:B8.description: A grid of stone blocks fills this cramped northwestern chamber, and one block near the middle shows fresh scrape marks at its base where it has been pushed aside and a ladder uncovered. Slime trails glisten in the lanes between the rows, and the air is close and dry. A locked door leads east, its keyhole crusted with dust.

L5:C8.name: Stair Landing
L5:C8.description: A bare stone landing where a narrow stair drops into the floor, running far to the southwest beneath the halls. Locked doors stand in the south and west walls, their keyholes cold and dark. The dust around the stair is scuffed by many feet, and a lizard is scratched on the top step pointing the way down.

L5:cellar:B8.name: Whistling Brick Cellar
L5:cellar:B8.description: Dry air whistles faintly through this narrow brick basement, a thin note like wind across a reed, from somewhere beneath the scraped block above. Brick ledges step across the dark floor, and a cache of rupees lies on the last of them, left by someone who meant to come back. The ladder is the only way back up.

L6:A1.name: Scorched Antechamber
L6:A1.description: Black scorch marks splash the walls of this chamber in starbursts, as if bolts of magic struck them from every side at once, and the dust shows the outlines of robed figures that appeared and vanished again. The smell of burnt air lingers. A locked door with a keyhole stands to the east, and the way north is open.

L6:B1.name: Dragon's Gate
L6:B1.description: Dragon statues of dark red stone flank the entry hall of this labyrinth, their jaws carved wide as if to breathe fire. Heat radiates from the walls themselves, and the air smells of singed cloth and spent spells. A locked door lies west and an open way leads east, and the stair behind climbs back to the highlands.

L6:C1.name: Rune-Scored Hall
L6:C1.description: Arcane sigils are scratched across the flagstones here, and a few still glow faintly before fading, the marks where robed sorcerers blink in and out of the room. Soot blackens the corners and the air prickles against the skin. A locked door is set into the north wall, and an open way leads west.

L6:A2.name: Slime Cistern
L6:A2.description: Puddles of green slime pool in the low places of this sunken floor, and trails of it streak the walls up to knee height, where large blobs have tried to climb. A rusted drain grate in the center gurgles softly, breathing up a cold, sour draught. Open ways lead north and south.

L6:C2.name: Cramped Ember Cell
L6:C2.description: Red-tinged walls press close around this cramped cell, and the air is sour with the smoke of a pair of fires that have burned here longer than anyone remembers. The stone between them is worn into a shallow dip, and a few squat blocks stand against the walls like forgotten stools. Scratched into one block is a crude eye with an arrow through its middle. The only way out is the locked door in the south wall.

L6:A3.name: Smoky Roost
L6:A3.description: A tall, narrow chamber whose ceiling vanishes into soot-black shadow, alive with the rustle of leathery wings that dart down and flutter up again. Droppings crust the floor and the red stone walls. A heavy shutter seals the north door, and an open way leads south.

L6:A4.name: Crossed Grooves of the Dragon
L6:A4.description: Grooves cut deep into the floor run from the corners toward the middle of this chamber, and the stone along them is nicked bright where spiked blades lunge at anything crossing their lines. A red dragon is carved on each blade's resting place. The rest of the room is bare and quiet, smelling of oil and hot iron. Shutters guard both the north and south doors.

L6:A5.name: Flickering Hall
L6:A5.description: The air here crackles with stray sparks, and patches of the walls are scorched into strange silhouettes by spells cast from robed figures that walk straight through stone. Two rows of blocks run along the room, their tops blistered by heat. A cold blue flicker bounces between them. Heavy shutters close the north and south doorways.

L6:B5.name: Taloned Corner
L6:B5.description: Deep talon gouges mark the tops of the blocks set around this corner chamber, and torn blue wing membrane hangs from a crack in the ceiling beside the tiny black wings of bats. The red flagstones are cool underfoot. Heavy shutters stand in the north and east doorways.

L6:C5.name: Sorcerer's Stair
L6:C5.description: A spiral of scorch marks curls across the floor of this chamber toward its center, laid down by blue-robed spellcasters who pass through walls. In the corner a narrow stair sinks into the floor, leading to distant halls far to the east. A shutter in the west wall is the only door.

L6:E5.name: Mage's Dead End
L6:E5.description: Burn marks of two colours, red-black and an eerie blue-grey, overlap on every wall of this isolated chamber, the signatures of two kinds of sorcerer. The air smells of ozone and singed stone, and the floor is gritty with ash. A shutter in the north wall is the only way out.

L6:A6.name: Statue Gallery
L6:A6.description: A line of dragon statues stands along the west wall, their stone faces blistered and cracked by stray spells, and the floor before them is pocked with the footprints of something that appears out of nothing. The east wall shows a crumbling patch of brick that looks thin. Heavy iron shutters close the north and south doors.

L6:B6.name: Ash Chamber
L6:B6.description: A drift of fine grey ash covers the floor, swirled into patterns by draughts that seem to come from nowhere and by robes that sweep through the walls. The west wall is cracked and weak, a shutter blocks the south, and a locked door with a scorched keyhole bars the north.

L6:E6.name: Threshold of the Nest
L6:E6.description: Grooves cut by sliding blades scar the floor, and blue scorch marks stain the walls of this hall. From behind the locked door in the north wall comes a dry rustle, the clatter of hard legs on stone, and the slow blink of something enormous. A shutter lies south and the east way is open.

L6:F6.name: Eastern Bend
L6:F6.description: This chamber at the eastern edge of the labyrinth smells of storm and singed fur. Sparks wink and vanish in the corners, and talon marks score the stone above the doorways where blue-winged things perch. A cracked dragon carving leans in one corner, its eyes chipped out. Open ways lead north and west.

L6:A7.name: Hushed Red Vault
L6:A7.description: Bare red stone and a ring of squat blocks are all this chamber holds, and the hush is so complete that every footfall rings off the walls and comes back doubled. A ring of old soot marks the lintel where a torch once hung, and the dust inside the circle of blocks lies thick and undisturbed. Heavy shutters guard the east and south doors.

L6:B7.name: Hall of Many Doors
L6:B7.description: Four doorways meet in this crowded hall: locked doors to the north and south, a shutter to the west and an open way east. The floor is smeared with slime and a sticky, glistening film beside a half-dissolved shield strap, and stray sparks snap in the corners. The walls are carved with coiling dragons.

L6:C7.name: Ember Hall
L6:C7.description: Glowing embers lie scattered in the cracks of this hall as though fire had rained from nowhere, flung by sorcerers who vanish and reappear between one breath and the next. The walls are scorched red-black in broad splashes, and the air is hot and dry. A shutter guards the north, and open ways lead east and west.

L6:D7.name: Northern Ascent
L6:D7.description: Low steps of red stone climb toward a shutter in the north wall, flanked by small dragon carvings with chipped snouts. Sparks crackle along the floor, and blue scorch marks streak the steps where spells have struck. An open way leads back west toward the ember-strewn hall.

L6:E7.name: Gohma's Nest
L6:E7.description: Shed carapace fragments and deep scuttle marks crisscross the floor of this lair, and the walls are gouged by great pincers. Broken arrows lie thick near the north wall, nearly all snapped against a hard shell. Above it all a single huge eye is carved, staring. A locked door lies south, and the door north is locked with the guardian's key.

L6:F7.name: Eastern Stairwell
L6:F7.description: A narrow stair sinks into the floor in one corner of this chamber, leading back toward the western halls. A sticky, glistening film coats the stones around it, the residue of something that swallows whatever is held out to it, and stray sparks snap in the air. The only door is the open way south.

L6:B8.name: Room of the Loose Block
L6:B8.description: Faint glyphs circle the floor of this northern chamber, and one of its blocks sits slightly askew, its base scraped bare of soot where it has been pushed aside to reveal a ladder. Burn marks of red and blue overlap on the walls. A locked door lies south and the east wall looks cracked and weak.

L6:C8.name: Hall of Weak Walls
L6:C8.description: Both the east and west walls of this hall are crazed with cracks around thin, poorly set patches of brick that a bomb would open. A sticky residue glistens across the floor beside bent shield rivets, and sparks crackle along the wall seams. A heavy shutter leads south, back toward the ember-strewn hall.

L6:D8.name: Dragon Brazier Hall
L6:D8.description: A pair of braziers wrought as coiled dragons sits at the far end of this quiet room, fire spilling from their open jaws. The floor between them is worn smooth by long vigil, and dry heat has crazed the red glaze of the tiles into fine webs. No fountain, flower or trace of green softens the place; it is all stone and ember. A shutter leads south, and the west wall is cracked and weak.

L6:E8.name: Dragon's Glowing Sanctum
L6:E8.description: Polished red stone glows with a soft golden light in this sanctum, warming the dragon carvings along its walls, every one turned toward an iron-banded chest locked on the floor. Over the chest a small triangle of light turns, waiting to carry the victor home. The heat and smoke of the halls below are gone. The door south, back to the nest, is locked with the Dragon's key.

L6:cellar:B8.name: Magical Rod Cellar
L6:cellar:B8.description: A ladder drops from beneath the loose block into a cramped basement of dark brick. Brick ledges step across a floor that hums with a faint, prickling power, the same power the sorcerers above spend so freely, and the air smells of ozone. The only way out is back up the ladder.

L7:A1.name: Hall of Shed Skins
L7:A1.description: Pale, papery snakeskins lie curled in the corners of this low chamber, and thin sinuous tracks wind through the grit, snapping into straight furrows wherever they line up with the door. The walls are cold and close, and a faint hiss lingers in the air long after any sound has stopped. The only way out is the open doorway to the north.

L7:B1.name: Demon's Gate
L7:B1.description: Damp stone steps come down from the drained pond above into a vestibule of green-black brick carved with a horned, grinning face. Water still beads on the walls and gathers in the seams between the floor tiles, and the air smells of silt and old reeds. The pond waits overhead for the tune that sent it away. Open archways lead north and east into the dark.

L7:C1.name: Dripping Antechamber
L7:C1.description: A bare square chamber whose blue-green flagstones are slick with seep from the pond overhead. The only sound is a slow, patient dripping that echoes from every wall, and green weed hangs from the ceiling where the water once stood. An open archway leads west toward the entry stair, and another opens north into deeper halls.

L7:A2.name: Blade Trap Corridor
L7:A2.description: Deep grooves are worn into the floor between the corners, where blocks of spiked iron sit in shallow recesses, polished bright by endless sliding at whoever crosses their line. The ceiling is low and hung with roosting stains where bats flit. A spiderweb of cracks runs through the east wall, and open doorways lead north and south.

L7:B2.name: Moat Crossroads
L7:B2.description: A channel of black water rings a raised island of flagstones at the heart of this room, its surface still and cold, and boomerang splinters float on it. Narrow stone lips along the walls let a traveller skirt the moat to reach the open doorways east and south. Both the north and west walls are fractured and hollow-looking, as if a bomb would bring them down.

L7:C2.name: Guano-Streaked Crossing
L7:C2.description: White streaks of guano stain the walls of this chamber from ceiling to floor, and the air is sour with it. The shadowed rafters overhead are crusted thick, and the floor is a mess of droppings and tiny cast-off bones. Open doorways lead west, east and south, while the north wall bears a jagged crack running from floor to lintel.

L7:D2.name: Shuttered Gallery
L7:D2.description: Two rows of squat stone blocks march down the middle of this long gallery, leaving narrow lanes between them. Boomerang notches are chipped into the brickwork at shoulder height, blue paint flaking in each one. A heavy iron shutter seals the north doorway, while open arches lead east and west.

L7:E2.name: Urchin's Hollow
L7:E2.description: Coarse sand has drifted across the floor of this chamber, and great round depressions are pressed into it as though a vast spiked ball had rolled from wall to wall. Broken spines as long as a forearm lie scattered among the dunes. The room is unnaturally quiet; even footsteps seem swallowed, though a shrill note would ring for a long time. Open arches lead east and west.

L7:F2.name: Bone-Strewn Alcove
L7:F2.description: The far eastern end of the dungeon gathers into a cramped alcove littered with skulls, ribs and rusted sword hilts. Some of the bones look disturbed, shuffled into heaps that were not there before and arranged as if they meant to stand up. The stale air carries a dry rattle, and the only way out is the open arch to the west.

L7:A3.name: Dodongo Den
L7:A3.description: Huge three-toed prints are pressed into the soot that coats this chamber, and the walls are scorched black in broad arcs where swallowed bombs went off inside something thick-hided. A reptilian musk hangs in the air with a whiff of brimstone. A sturdy locked door with an iron keyhole stands in the north wall; open doorways lead east and south.

L7:B3.name: Boomerang Hall
L7:B3.description: A square hall of green brick whose walls are gouged with curved nicks where thrown blades have struck and spun back to red and blue hands. A worn track circles the floor around a single central block. A heavy shutter seals the east doorway, the south wall is cracked through, and open arches lead north and west.

L7:C3.name: Hall of Bones
L7:C3.description: Raised blocks stand in a checkerboard across this wide chamber, and every lane between them is choked with bones, shields and helmets green with age, some of which climb to their feet and hop toward the living. The clatter of loose ribs underfoot sets echoes running along the walls. A heavy shutter guards the west doorway, and the south wall is split by a ragged crack.

L7:D3.name: Hall of the Horned Mask
L7:D3.description: A great horned mask is worked into the back wall of this bare room, its features worn soft with age and its long nose running down toward the floor. Below its chin two fires burn in plain stone braziers, and their light dances across a floor rubbed smooth where someone has long stood. The rest of the hall is empty and swept. A heavy shutter seals the south doorway.

L7:A4.name: Demon's Powder Store
L7:A4.description: Small and square, this room feels strangely safe after the halls below, and the smell of black powder lingers in its corners. Low braziers crackle on either side of a polished patch of floor, and on a ledge between them sits a bulging bomb bag, a price of 100 rupees painted on the stone beneath it. Rows of iron hooks line the walls, all empty. The only way out is the iron-banded door with a keyhole in the south wall.

L7:B4.name: Hall of Lingering Chill
L7:B4.description: An unnatural chill pools near the floor of this chamber, and the torchless walls glimmer with a faint, shifting light where a flaming skull bounces from corner to corner. Pairs of stone blocks flank the center like silent guards. An open arch leads south, and a heavy iron shutter seals the passage north.

L7:A5.name: Western Moat
L7:A5.description: A broad moat cuts across this chamber, its dark water lapping softly against a narrow causeway of stone that bends toward the far doors, a crossing too narrow to fight on comfortably. The smell of wet moss is thick, and boomerang splinters drift in the water. A locked door with a brass keyhole stands to the north, and a heavy shutter seals the east doorway.

L7:B5.name: Island Chamber
L7:B5.description: A ring of still water surrounds a square island of flagstones in the middle of this room, and the reflections of the walls ripple whenever a drop falls from the ceiling. No tracks mark the island. Heavy shutters seal the south and west doorways. The east wall is crumbling and hollow-sounding, as if little holds it together but habit.

L7:C5.name: Hidden Cistern
L7:C5.description: Behind a broken wall lies a small forgotten cistern, its floor sunk a step lower than the rest of the dungeon and slick with standing water. Moss grows thick in the corners, and the air is close and still. This is the tip of the demon's nose, and the only way out is the ragged gap in the west wall.

L7:A6.name: Hall of Grumbling
L7:A6.description: Gnawed bones and an empty clay bowl lie before the north doorway, and a deep, hungry grumble rises from the stones. GRUMBLE, GRUMBLE... is scratched over and over on the door frame in a clumsy, clawed hand. Whoever keeps this passage is plainly starving and will let no one by on an empty stomach; a little bait might help. A heavy shutter seals the north, and a locked door stands south.

L7:B6.name: Stairwell of the Demon
L7:B6.description: A narrow stone stair drops away through the floor in one corner of this chamber, descending into a long, dripping passage that runs far beneath the dungeon. The surrounding blocks are carved with leering, horned faces, and boomerang nicks pock the walls. The east wall is cracked and blistered from some great heat beyond it.

L7:C6.name: Hall of the Horned Ledge
L7:C6.description: A long hall of scorched brick ends at a raised ledge where something huge and horned has worn the stone smooth. The walls are pocked with blackened craters in clusters of three, each a fan of fireballs spat at once, and the floor is gritty with flaked soot. A cracked wall leads back west, and the door east is locked, a horned face around its keyhole.

L7:D6.name: Demon's Stepped Sanctum
L7:D6.description: A hush fills this small, high chamber, broken only by a faint golden hum from the stones themselves. The floor rises in shallow steps to a dais where an iron-banded chest stands locked, a gold triangle set into the step before it, and above the dais turns a triangle of light that leads home. The only way out is the door west, locked with the Demon's key.

L7:A7.name: Teeming Moat Hall
L7:A7.description: Dark water runs in a broad channel around the edges of this crowded hall, leaving a broad central floor scattered with feathers, droppings and chipped boomerang wood, and a cold blue flicker hops among the litter. The noise of the place never quite stops. A locked door stands east, a shutter seals the south, and the north wall is visibly cracked.

L7:B7.name: Twin Pillar Hall
L7:B7.description: Two massive square pillars of green stone rise from the floor of this hall, their bases worn smooth where countless hands have steadied themselves and dented where boomerangs struck. Water trickles in a thin sheet down the north wall beside a heavy shutter. A locked door leads west, and the east wall is fractured and loose.

L7:C7.name: Hall of the Loose Block
L7:C7.description: Blocks of carved stone stand in neat rows across this chamber, all but one set firmly into the floor. That one sits a finger's width out of line, with fresh scrape marks in the dust beside it and a faint smell of hot wax rising from beneath. Both the east and west walls are cracked through, as though once broken and badly mended.

L7:D7.name: Hall of Keyholes
L7:D7.description: Two stout doors banded with iron face this chamber from the north and east, each with a dark keyhole at its heart. Between them the floor is laid in a tight spiral of tiles that draws the eye inward, and boomerang splinters are swept into its center. The west wall is cracked from floor to ceiling and looks ready to give.

L7:E7.name: Spined Sand Pit
L7:E7.description: Fine sand has been heaped into ridges across this chamber, ploughed into furrows by something round, spiked and heavy. Snapped spines jut from the drifts like broken arrows, and the hush is deep enough to ring in the ears, the kind of silence a recorder's note would shatter. A locked door leads west, and a heavy shutter seals the north.

L7:A8.name: Forgotten Corner
L7:A8.description: Dust lies undisturbed on the floor of this sealed corner chamber, and cobwebs drape the bare walls in grey veils. No door was ever hung here; the only ways in are the crumbling walls to the south and east, which sound hollow and fragile to the touch. A horned face carved over the empty lintel seems to be laughing at whoever bothered.

L7:B8.name: Northern Moat Room
L7:B8.description: A moat of black water bends around three sides of this chamber, leaving a raised stone floor where scraps of goriya armour lie rusting beside red and blue boomerang splinters. The water smells of rot and iron. Heavy shutters seal the east and south doorways, and the west wall is split by a long, deep crack.

L7:C8.name: Goriya Barracks
L7:C8.description: Matted heaps of straw line the walls of this cramped room, and half-carved boomerangs and wood shavings litter the floor beside a cold firepit. It smells of fur and stale meat, and blue paint is daubed on every bedroll. The only way out is the heavy shutter in the west wall.

L7:D8.name: Vault of the Sleeping Face
L7:D8.description: Smooth slabs of dark stone line this small, empty vault at the top of the dungeon, and they drink the light. No track crosses its dust, and the dripping heard elsewhere does not reach here. A horned face is carved on the ceiling, eyes closed and mouth set in a thin line. The only exit is the locked door to the south.

L7:E8.name: Smoke-Stained Den
L7:E8.description: The ceiling of this low den is blackened with old smoke, and great scaly hide scrapings cling to the corners where something heavy and bomb-swallowing has rubbed itself against the brick. A sulphurous fug hangs over the floor. A heavy shutter seals the south doorway, and the east wall is fractured and weak.

L7:F8.name: Grasping Wall Chamber
L7:F8.description: Long gouges run down the walls of this chamber as if great hands had dragged themselves out of the stone and back again, hauling whatever they caught back to the dungeon's mouth. A stone stair in one corner leads down into a dripping passage that winds far to the west. The west wall is cracked and loose.

L7:cellar:C7.name: Waxen Ledge Cellar
L7:cellar:C7.description: Below the loose block a ladder descends into a narrow basement of rough red brick. A single ledge runs the length of the cellar above a black, bottomless gap, and the air is warm and faintly waxy. Rupees glint at the far end of the ledge, a hoard nobody came back for. The ladder rises back to the hall above.

L8:B1.name: Spiced Linen Crypt
L8:B1.description: Shreds of yellowed linen cling to the corners of this cold crypt, and the air carries a dry, spiced smell of old embalming. Stone blocks stand in a neat row along the floor, one of them resting a little crooked, with scrape marks at its base and the smell of old pages rising from beneath. A heavy shutter seals the east doorway.

L8:C1.name: Western Antechamber
L8:C1.description: A plain chamber of pale grey brick, its floor swept bare save for a few drifts of ash carried in from the entry stair. A stone lion lies across the lintel of the west door, mane chipped. The silence is heavy and expectant. An open arch leads east, and a heavy iron shutter seals the west doorway.

L8:D1.name: Lion's Gate
L8:D1.description: Fine grey ash sifts down the stair from the burned bush overhead, settling on the first flagstones of a stern stone vestibule. Carved lion heads glare from the corners, their stone manes chipped with age and their jaws open on darkness. Open archways lead west, north and east.

L8:E1.name: Eastern Roost
L8:E1.description: Droppings streak the walls of this small dead-end chamber, and a faint chill lingers near the floor no matter how still the air, where a flaming skull's glow bounces and fades. Fluttering echoes come and go from the shadowed ceiling. The only way out is the open arch to the west.

L8:D2.name: Narrow Passage Hall
L8:D2.description: A tall, narrow hall of grey stone runs north from the entry, its walls lined with shallow alcoves where stone lions once crouched. Only their broken paws remain. The open arch south leads back to the gate, and the north wall is cracked and crumbling, as if begging for a bomb.

L8:B3.name: Quiet Western Cell
L8:B3.description: A small, forgotten cell at the western edge of the dungeon, its floor clean and its walls unmarked but for a tiny lion scratched by the door. A thin draught sighs through the open arch to the east, carrying the faint smell of damp stone. Nothing here seems to have been disturbed in a very long time.

L8:C3.name: Hall of Echoes
L8:C3.description: Every sound in this high chamber comes back doubled and trebled from the bare walls, so that a single footstep becomes a march, and the long-eared things that hop here hate loud noise above all. Tufts of pale fur cling to the corners. Open arches lead west and north, and a heavy iron shutter seals the doorway east.

L8:D3.name: Slime-Slick Crossing
L8:D3.description: Glistening trails of green slime crisscross the flagstones of this four-way chamber, and the floor gives a faint squelch underfoot where large blobs have split into smaller ones. A locked door with a keyhole stands to the east, heavy shutters guard the north and west, and the south wall is cracked through.

L8:E3.name: Warren of Long Ears
L8:E3.description: Pale fur drifts like snow across the floor of this crowded chamber, and the walls are scuffed low down by countless thumping feet. The air is warm and musky, and even the slightest sound sets something stirring; arrows lie broken in the corners where hunters found their mark. A locked door leads back west.

L8:A4.name: Gel-Streaked Chamber
L8:A4.description: Puddles of quivering green gel cling to the floor of this chamber, and wet smears trail up the base of the walls where they tried to climb. The air is damp and smells faintly sweet and rotten. An open arch leads north, and a heavy shutter seals the east doorway.

L8:B4.name: Stair Beneath the Lion
L8:B4.description: A steep stone stair opens in one corner of this chamber, leading down into a passage that runs far to the east beneath the dungeon. A great stone lion's head is carved above the stairwell, and pale fur lies in its open jaws. The west doorway is shuttered, and the north wall is scorched and cracked by the heat of the lair beyond.

L8:C4.name: Hall of Crouching Lions
L8:C4.description: Four stone lions crouch at the corners of this square hall, their blank eyes fixed on the middle of the floor. The paving between them is cracked in a starburst pattern, as if something heavy fell there long ago. An open arch leads south, a heavy shutter seals the north, and a locked door stands to the east.

L8:D4.name: Locked Crossway
L8:D4.description: Two iron-bound doors with dark keyholes face this chamber from the north and west, and the floor between them is slick with old slime. A faint chill clings near the ceiling where a cold blue glow drifts, and the walls weep a cold sweat. A heavy shutter seals the south doorway.

L8:A5.name: Lion's Warm Hearth
L8:A5.description: Warmth fills this small room from a pair of fires burning at its heart, and their glow catches the brass eyes of a lion's head set high on the north wall. Between the braziers the stones are worn smooth. Ten notches are scored in a neat row along the lion's mane, the last cut deeper than all the rest. An open arch leads south, and the east wall is cracked and weak.

L8:B5.name: Hall of Four Gouges
L8:B5.description: Four deep troughs are gouged into the north wall where four long dragon necks thrashed against the stone, and the floor below is blackened and pocked with bite marks from severed heads that kept on flying. The air tastes of ash. Cracked walls lead south and west, and the door north is locked, a lion's head around its keyhole.

L8:C5.name: Ash-Grey Watch Chamber
L8:C5.description: Ash drifts in the corners of this little chamber, blown in by a draught that carries the cold, thin smell of high mountain air. Twin fires crackle on either side of a worn spot in the floor, and above them a faded mural shows a jagged peak with two round boulders perched on its shoulder like a pair of spectacles. The only way out is the heavy shutter to the south.

L8:D5.name: Chamber of Three Doors
L8:D5.description: A plain chamber of grey stone where three very different ways out meet: a locked door with a keyhole to the south, a heavy iron shutter to the east, and a north wall split by a deep, ragged crack. A lion's head glowers over each. The floor is bare and the silence is heavy.

L8:E5.name: Knight's Guardroom
L8:E5.description: Dented shields and broken spear shafts are stacked against the walls of this guardroom, and the floor is scored by the tread of heavy armoured boots that pace and turn to face every door. Strips of old linen hang from a rack. A stone stair in the corner leads down into a passage running west, and a shutter seals the west doorway.

L8:B6.name: Lion's Last Sanctum
L8:B6.description: Golden light glows faintly from the walls of this small, still chamber, though no flame burns anywhere within it. On a plain stone dais stands an iron-banded chest, locked, the last of the eight that keep the shards of wisdom, and beside it a triangle of light turns to carry the victor home. The only way out is the door south, locked with the Lion's key, back toward the scorched lair.

L8:C6.name: Lion's Den
L8:C6.description: A large stone lion lies carved along the length of the west wall, its head resting on its paws as though asleep and one eye half open. The rest of the chamber is empty, cool and very still, with no track in the dust. An open arch leads north, and the east wall is cracked through.

L8:D6.name: Cartographer's Hall
L8:D6.description: Faded lines are scratched into the walls of this hall, as though someone once tried to chart the lion-shaped dungeon on its very stones and gave up halfway. A locked door with a keyhole stands in the north wall, and both the south and west walls are cracked and hollow-sounding.

L8:C7.name: Burrow Chamber
L8:C7.description: Shallow scrapes and burrow holes pock the earthen corners of this chamber, and tufts of pale fur catch on every rough edge. The quiet here is uneasy, broken by faint scratching and the twitch of long ears that flinch at any loud sound. An open arch leads south, and the east wall is fractured and weak.

L8:D7.name: Northern Crossroads
L8:D7.description: A broad chamber where four ways meet: heavy iron shutters to the north and east, a locked door with a keyhole to the south, and a cracked wall to the west. Carved lions' heads glower down from the lintel of every door. The floor is clean and bare, and the air is cool.

L8:E7.name: Hall of the Shifted Block
L8:E7.description: Rows of grey blocks fill this chamber, and green slime glistens in the gaps between them. One block stands slightly out of line, a curved scrape in the floor showing where it has been moved before, and a faint metallic chime rises from beneath it. A heavy shutter seals the west doorway.

L8:D8.name: Ooze-Drenched Chamber
L8:D8.description: The northernmost chamber of the dungeon is slick with puddles of trembling green ooze that cling to the walls in thick, dripping sheets and split apart when struck. The air is damp and cloying. The only way out is the heavy shutter in the south wall.

L8:cellar:B1.name: Magic Book Cellar
L8:cellar:B1.description: Beneath the crooked block, a ladder leads down into a narrow basement of rough brick that smells of dust and old parchment. A single stone ledge runs above a dark drop, and faint chalk runes mark the walls, some of them scorched as if a page once set fire to whatever it touched. The ladder climbs back to the tomb above.

L8:cellar:E7.name: Cellar of the Doorless Keyhole
L8:cellar:E7.description: From the shifted block a ladder descends into a cramped brick basement, its far end crossed by a single stone ledge above a black gap. A keyhole is carved on the far wall with no door around it, and beneath it someone has stacked a little hoard of rupees. The ladder leads back up to the hall above.

L9:B1.name: Stairwell Antechamber
L9:B1.description: A narrow dead-end chamber at the dungeon's southern edge, its walls pressing close and its ceiling low. Damp seeps from the dark basalt and pools in the cracks of the floor, red-tinged as if the mountain bled. A stair in one corner plunges into a tunnel running east beneath the rock, and an open doorway leads back north.

L9:D1.name: Chamber of Locked Doors
L9:D1.description: Scorch marks spatter the walls here in uneven arcs, the work of fire beams flung by robed sorcerers who blink from one corner to the next. The room is a small stone box with no open way out at all: a stout locked door stands in the north wall and another in the east, both with keyholes rimmed in tarnished brass.

L9:E1.name: Furrowed Sand Pit
L9:E1.description: Loose grey sand covers the floor of this chamber, churned into long winding furrows where a segmented, many-legged thing has burst up, raced across the room in a blur, and dived back down again and again. The air tastes of grit. A locked door with a keyhole stands in the west wall, and a stairway sunk in the sand descends into a passage running west.

L9:G1.name: Gate Beneath Spectacle Rock
L9:G1.description: Cold air pours down from the mountain's heart into this bare stone vestibule, carved where the twin crags of Spectacle Rock meet the ground. The walls are rough, sooty basalt veined with dull red, shaped above the door into the brow of an enormous skull. Above the north arch eight triangular sockets are cut, one for every shard of wisdom. A low rumble comes from the rock itself.

L9:B2.name: Eye of the Western Hall
L9:B2.description: A swirl of dust turns slowly in the middle of this chamber, stirred by some unseen current that circles and circles again, the trail of a great eye ringed by smaller ones that orbit it. The walls are smooth, dark stone, and a flight of steps in the floor descends into a hidden underground passage. Open doorways lead north, south and east.

L9:C2.name: Roost of the Keese
L9:C2.description: Bat droppings crust the ledges of this low, vaulted room, and the ceiling is pocked with crevices where dozens of small wings rustle and dart in the dark. Rows of rough blocks line the floor like broken teeth. An open doorway leads west, and a locked door with a heavy keyhole guards the way east.

L9:D2.name: Slime-Slick Junction
L9:D2.description: The floor of this chamber glistens with a film of greenish ooze that clings to the boots and smells of rot, and big green blobs split in two when they are struck. Iron-bound doors with keyholes stand in the north, south and west walls, and only the east archway hangs open. In one corner, steps cut into the stone drop away into a narrow underground passage.

L9:E2.name: Crossroads of Ash
L9:E2.description: Four squat blocks stand in a square at the room's center, their tops dusted with grey ash that drifts down from somewhere far above. Sticky slime trails and scraps of swallowed shields curl between them, and scorch marks dapple the flagstones. Open archways lead west, north and east, and here the dungeon's paths first begin to divide.

L9:F2.name: Scorched Vestibule
L9:F2.description: Blackened rings and starbursts of soot mark the floor and walls, as though bolts of fire have been hurled here again and again by sorcerers in red and blue robes. The smell of burnt stone hangs in the still air. A shutter bars the way east, an open passage runs west, and the northern wall shows a web of fine cracks around one patch of mortar.

L9:G2.name: Mountain Gate Fireside
L9:G2.description: Black rock walls swallow most of the light thrown by the iron braziers that flank a worn patch of floor, and the corners stay dark however the flames leap. Soot streaks the ceiling in long fingers. Set into the floor before the fires is an empty triangular socket, its edges polished by countless fingertips. Heavy shutters seal the west and north walls, while the archway south opens back toward the mountain gate.

L9:A3.name: Ooze-Pooled Corner
L9:A3.description: Puddles of thick ooze collect in the hollows of the uneven floor, quivering and splitting whenever a breath of air passes. The corner chamber is dim and cramped, its walls blotched with mildew and red-veined basalt. A shutter seals the east wall, and a locked door with a keyhole leads north.

L9:B3.name: Hall of Half-Eaten Shields
L9:B3.description: Bent shield straps and dissolved scraps of leather lie scattered across the floor, coated in a clear, sticky residue, and the walls bulge with tubelike shapes that swallow whatever touches them. The room smells of something that digests slowly. Shutters guard the north and west, and an open archway leads south.

L9:C3.name: Whirling Dust Chamber
L9:C3.description: Grit hangs in the air in a slow, circling cloud, as if the room itself were a whirlpool of dust spun by a great eye and its ring of lesser eyes. Ranks of blocks line the walls, and in one corner a stair leads down into a tunnel that runs far beneath the dungeon. An open doorway leads east and a shutter seals the north.

L9:D3.name: Hall of Shadows and Flame
L9:D3.description: Scorch marks, slime trails, swallowed shield straps and a strange chill all share this crowded chamber, as if every terror of the mountain passed through it on its way to the dark lord's hall. Two lines of blocks divide the floor into lanes. A locked door leads south, an open doorway west, and one section of the north wall looks thin and crumbling.

L9:E3.name: Hall of Twin Pillars
L9:E3.description: Two great pillars of black stone flank the center of this room, each wrapped in a spiral of soot from fire beams that struck and glanced away. The silence here is heavy, broken only by the faint pop of a sorcerer arriving from nowhere. Open archways lead north and south, while the eastern wall bears a long hairline crack.

L9:F3.name: The Sealed Sand Hollow
L9:F3.description: Every wall of this sandy chamber is solid and doorless, but each shows a faint web of cracks where the stone has been weakened, waiting for bombs. Long red furrows wind through the sand where something many-legged tunnels at terrible speed. A stairway in one corner sinks into a tunnel leading north, the only clear way out.

L9:G3.name: Gallery of Ooze
L9:G3.description: Slime coats the lower walls of this long gallery in shining streaks, a sticky film clings where shields have been swallowed, and a cold, unnatural shiver hangs near the corners where a flaming skull bounces. The floor is set with scattered blocks. A shutter lies to the south, an open doorway north, and the west wall shows a cracked and sagging patch.

L9:H3.name: Eastern Spellward
L9:H3.description: A secluded chamber at the dungeon's eastern edge, its walls branded with soot in strange, star-shaped patterns where sorcerers in blue robes step out of the stone itself. Rows of dark blocks stand in neat columns down its length. The only way out is an open archway to the north.

L9:A4.name: Corridor of Burnt Runes
L9:A4.description: The western wall of this narrow room is carved with runes, and most of them have been scorched black by passing fire beams. The air is warm and dry and smells of smoke and ozone. Locked doors with keyholes lead north and south, and the room offers no other way through.

L9:B4.name: Hall of Grinding Blades
L9:B4.description: Deep grooves are worn into the floor in straight lines from each corner toward the center, where spiked blades have slammed back and forth countless times at anything that crossed them. Torn leather scraps lie in sticky heaps where shields were swallowed. The trick is to move fast before the traps reset. Shutters stand at the north and south ends.

L9:C4.name: Ganon's Dark Chamber
L9:C4.description: Darkness fills this vast hall so completely that no lamp pushes it back. The air is hot and foul with the reek of a great boar, and fireballs have left scorch marks in rings around a lord who cannot be seen until struck. Claw marks appear where nothing stands, and heaps of ash wait to take a fallen shape. Shutters stand south, and on the north wall a golden door gleams, sealed with a heavy lock.

L9:D4.name: Sealed Alcove of Embers
L9:D4.description: Sealed away behind crumbling stone, this small alcove smells of cold ash and old candle wax. Twin fires crackle beside a patch of floor worn smooth by long vigil, and their light finds a row of carved skulls along the ceiling ledge, every empty eye socket stained darker than the bone around it. The only way back is through the south wall, a cracked and weak-looking stretch with grit at its foot.

L9:E4.name: Chamber of Scorch Rings
L9:E4.description: Overlapping rings of black soot cover the floor, many layers deep, as though red-robed sorcerers appeared in every corner at once and loosed fire beams into the middle. Heat lingers in the stone long after the flames have gone. Open archways lead east and south.

L9:F4.name: Crowded Sorcery Hall
L9:F4.description: Slime, soot, swallowed shield straps and a lingering cold chill mark this busy hall in equal measure. Low blocks stand in pairs across the floor, leaving narrow lanes where the robed casters blink in and out. A doorway opens west, a locked door with a keyhole leads east, and the south wall looks cracked and weak.

L9:G4.name: Hall of Blue Flames
L9:G4.description: Strange pale scorch marks, more blue than black, streak the walls of this chamber where blue-robed sorcerers walk straight through stone and cast as they come. The air crackles faintly with leftover magic. The floor is bare except for a few scattered blocks. A locked door leads west and an open doorway leads south.

L9:H4.name: Eastern Wardroom
L9:H4.description: A cold draught whispers through this chamber, and with it comes a strange unease that makes the torchlight waver, as flaming skulls bounce off the walls and leave a numbness behind. Soot stains streak the walls between plain stone blocks. Open archways lead north and south along the dungeon's eastern edge.

L9:A5.name: Blade-Trap Stairwell
L9:A5.description: Deep grooves cut the floor from each corner, worn by spiked blades that slam toward the center, and soot marks the walls above them where sorcerers have joined the ambush. A locked door leads south, the east wall bears a crumbling, fractured section, and a stair in the floor descends into a long passage beneath the dungeon.

L9:B5.name: Hall of Many Dangers
L9:B5.description: Signs of every kind of menace crowd this hall: slime trails, swallowed shield straps, scorched stone, and a strange chill clinging to the walls. Blocks stand in a ring around the center. Shutters lead north and south, and a cracked patch in the west wall hints at a hidden way, as though the skull of the mountain had an eye there.

L9:C5.name: Princess Zelda's Chamber
L9:C5.description: Warm light fills this quiet room, cast by two fires burning on either side of its center. After the darkness below, the air is clean and still. Between the fires squats a great chest of black iron and gold, and above it a golden triangle of light hangs, waiting for the ninth piece to join the eight. The golden door south leads back to the dark chamber.

L9:D5.name: Pool of Gel
L9:D5.description: Small, jiggling droplets of jelly cling to every surface of this room, quivering with a life of their own and hopping from tile to tile. The floor is slick and gives off a sour, wet smell. A locked door with a keyhole leads north, and the east wall shows a thin, crumbling section.

L9:E5.name: Bat-Haunted Gallery
L9:E5.description: The rustle of leathery wings never quite stops in this high gallery, and droppings streak the walls below its dark ledges where bats cluster by the dozen. A thin crack runs through the western wall. An open archway leads north. The stone underfoot is cold and gritty, and the air smells of must.

L9:F5.name: Chamber of the Needle
L9:F5.description: A narrow chamber, its walls scarred with scorch marks that point in every direction like the arms of a compass rose, burned there by sorcerers in red and blue. The floor is laid with a pattern of dark and pale tiles. The only visible way out is a stretch of cracked and weakened stone in the north wall.

L9:G5.name: Murky Junction
L9:G5.description: Ooze, bat droppings and a strange lingering cold make this room an unpleasant place to linger, and a flaming skull's light flickers across the blocks. Rows of blocks divide the floor. A locked door with a keyhole leads north, and the east wall shows a long, fractured seam in the stone.

L9:H5.name: Belfry of the Vires
L9:H5.description: High overhead, the ceiling vanishes into blackness where horned, blue-winged things roost and hop down to strike, and claw marks rake the upper walls. Shattered bits of stone and the tiny wings of bats they split into litter the floor. An open archway leads south, while cracked sections mar both the north and west walls.

L9:A6.name: Western Stair Room
L9:A6.description: Scorched rings mark the floor around a stair that sinks into a tunnel running beneath the dungeon, and fresh scorch trails show where sorcerers stepped out of the walls to meet whoever came up. The walls here are thick and dark, and the air is uncomfortably warm. There is no open doorway, but the north wall shows a web of fractures.

L9:B6.name: Circling Wind Chamber
L9:B6.description: A slow, endless wind circles this room, carrying fine dust round and round the walls in the wake of an orbiting ring of eyes. Swirling marks are scoured into the floor, wider in some places than others, as if the ring sometimes swells outward. Shutters lead north and south, and a cracked section of the east wall looks ready to give way.

L9:C6.name: Hall of Slime and Shadow
L9:C6.description: Pools of slime gleam on the floor in the shadow of tall stone blocks, a sticky film marks where shields were swallowed, and a strange chill hangs near the walls. Locked doors with keyholes lead north and east, while the western wall shows a crumbling, fractured patch. The air is damp.

L9:D6.name: Gel-Choked Crossway
L9:D6.description: Tiny quivering blobs of jelly cling to the walls and floor of this crossing, leaving a slick, sour-smelling film everywhere and sticking to the boots of anyone who passes. Locked doors with keyholes stand in the north, south and west walls, and a cracked section of the east wall looks weak.

L9:E6.name: Winged Watchtower
L9:E6.description: The ceiling here rises into a tall, dark shaft, and claw marks streak its upper walls where heavy blue wings have gripped the stone and horned shapes have dropped on intruders. A cold draught spills down from above. Open archways lead north and south, and the west wall bears a thin crack.

L9:F6.name: Ooze-Streaked Passage
L9:F6.description: Streaks of slime run down the walls of this narrow chamber, a few shield rivets lie in a sticky puddle, and a cold, uneasy feeling lingers in the air. Rows of dark blocks line the floor. A locked door leads east, while the north and south walls both show cracked, weakened stone.

L9:G6.name: Hall of Quivering Gel
L9:G6.description: Little blobs of jelly quiver on every flagstone, leaving sticky trails behind them and hopping in short bursts toward any warmth. The room smells sour and damp. An open archway leads north, locked doors stand to the south and west, and a cracked patch scars the east wall.

L9:H6.name: The Cartographer's Vault
L9:H6.description: Dust spins in a slow circle across the floor of this sealed eastern vault, as if stirred by an endless breath, and the walls are scored by the orbit of many small eyes. Faded lines are etched into the stone like old surveyors' marks. There are no doorways at all, only cracked and weakened sections in the north, south and west walls.

L9:A7.name: Sealed Western Sanctum
L9:A7.description: Scorch marks and a strange chill fill this isolated corner room, and the floor is laid with a careful arrangement of stone blocks. One block in the middle of the east side sits slightly out of line with the rest, its base scraped clean, and a silver gleam seems to show in the crack beneath. The only exit is a cracked section of the south wall.

L9:B7.name: Sand Burrow Hall
L9:B7.description: Coarse grey sand fills this hall, heaped into ridges and churned by long winding furrows where a segmented, many-legged thing races beneath the surface. A dry, earthy smell rises from the disturbed ground. Shutters stand at the north and south ends, and here and there the sand has collapsed into hollows.

L9:C7.name: Red Sand Hall
L9:C7.description: The sand on this floor is rust-red and churned into deep twisting furrows, as if something long and segmented has been tunnelling here without rest, surfacing only to charge. Locked doors with keyholes lead east and south, and a shutter seals the north. The air is dry and close.

L9:D7.name: Silent Cell
L9:D7.description: A small, quiet chamber with a strange chill in the air that gathers and drifts without any wind, the cold trail of a bouncing skull. The floor is bare and the walls plain basalt. Locked doors with keyholes lead south and west, and there is no other way out.

L9:E7.name: Stair of the Devourers
L9:E7.description: Sticky residue coats the floor around a stair that drops into a tunnel running deep beneath the dungeon, and scraps of chewed leather and bent shield rims lie in heaps along the walls. Whatever lives here swallows first and spits out later. An open archway leads south, and a locked door with a keyhole guards the east.

L9:F7.name: Blue-Scorched Hall
L9:F7.description: Pale bluish scorch marks streak the walls in straight lines, crossing and recrossing one another where blue-robed sorcerers have stepped through the stone and cast. The air carries the sharp smell of spent magic. An open doorway leads east, a locked door west, and the south wall shows a web of cracks.

L9:G7.name: Northern Whirl Chamber
L9:G7.description: A slow vortex of dust circles the center of this chamber, endlessly turning in the wake of a great eye and the ring of smaller eyes that swing around it. The walls are smooth and dark, lined with low blocks. An open doorway leads west and another south, and a locked door with a keyhole guards the north.

L9:H7.name: Eastern Gauntlet
L9:H7.description: Slime, soot, swallowed shield straps and a lingering cold chill fill this long chamber, every trace of danger crowded into one place. Rows of blocks run along the walls. Cracked and weakened sections of stone mark both the north and south walls, and nothing else leads out.

L9:B8.name: Northwestern Den
L9:B8.description: Ooze, bat droppings and a strange lingering chill make this dim corner chamber unwelcoming, the top of the skull-shaped dungeon where little light ever reaches. Low blocks are scattered across the floor. A shutter leads south, and a locked door with a heavy keyhole guards the way east.

L9:C8.name: Chamber of Watching Eyes
L9:C8.description: Long shadows waver across the bare stone of this quiet chamber, thrown by twin fires burning on either side of a worn spot on the floor. Painted on the plaster above them, half flaked away, is a great eye ringed by smaller eyes, and beside it the outline of a folded parchment. The air hums faintly, as though something beyond the walls is turning. A shutter leads south and a locked door west.

L9:D8.name: Stair of Slime
L9:D8.description: Slime coats the walls of this room in glistening sheets, a sticky film marks the floor where shields have been swallowed, and a cold presence drifts near the ceiling. A stair in one corner descends into a long tunnel beneath the dungeon. The east wall shows a cracked and crumbling patch.

L9:E8.name: Quiet Stair Landing
L9:E8.description: A small, empty chamber, strangely still after the rest of the dungeon, with no soot, slime or track anywhere. A worn stair in the floor descends into a passage that runs far to the west and south. The west wall shows a web of fine cracks in the stone. Dust lies thick and undisturbed.

L9:F8.name: Northern Stair of Flame
L9:F8.description: Scorch marks blacken the walls around a stair that plunges into a tunnel leading back toward the dungeon's southern halls, and the dust still holds the scorched footprints of sorcerers who appeared from nowhere. The air here is warm and smells of smoke. A cracked section of the east wall is the only other way out.

L9:G8.name: Whispering Hearth Room
L9:G8.description: Barely wider than a corridor, this room holds two flickering fires, a worn patch of floor between them and almost nothing else. A cold draught threads through the cracks of the west wall and tugs the flames sideways, as if beckoning onward. Faded footprints lead from the fires toward that wall and stop. A locked door with a keyhole leads south, and the west wall shows a cracked and weakened section.

L9:H8.name: Northeastern Sanctum
L9:H8.description: Scorch marks and a lingering cold presence fill this remote corner room, set where the eye of the mountain's skull would be. Stone blocks stand in neat rows, but one sits slightly out of line, with fresh scrapes at its base and a faint red glow in the crack beneath. The only exit is a cracked section of the south wall.

L9:cellar:A7.name: Silver Arrow Cellar
L9:cellar:A7.description: A ladder leads up from this narrow, side-cut basement, its walls of dark brick stacked in even rows. A hush hangs over the place, broken only by the drip of water somewhere in the dark, and a cold silver light seems to gather at the far end, the colour of the only thing that can finish the dark lord. The floor runs level to a raised ledge.

L9:cellar:H8.name: Red Ring Cellar
L9:cellar:H8.description: A narrow basement hollowed from the mountain's rock, reached by a ladder that rises toward the chamber above. The brick walls are warm to the touch, and a faint red glow lingers in the dust like the light through a ruby, a warmth that seems to promise blows will land softer. A raised ledge stands at the far end of the level floor.

wooden_sword_cave.name: The Old Man's Cave
wooden_sword_cave.description: A low cave opens into the hillside, its walls black with the soot of two fires that never burn down. Scratched into the rock above the fires, in a careful old hand: IT'S DANGEROUS TO GO ALONE! TAKE THIS. Beneath it, smaller: NINE GUARDIANS, IN ORDER. EACH KEEPS A KEY; EACH KEY A CHEST; EACH CHEST A PIECE OF THE TRIFORCE AND WHAT THE NEXT DUNGEON ASKS OF YOU.

white_sword_cave.name: The White Sword Cave
white_sword_cave.description: Spray from the waterfall drifts in at the mouth of this cave and beads on the rock. Two fires burn in shallow pits against the far wall, throwing a steady light across a floor scored by the boots of the few who climbed this high. Carved between the fires are the words: MASTER USING IT AND YOU CAN HAVE THIS. Only those whose hearts have grown strong are welcome to read them.

master_sword_grave.name: Beneath the Hero's Grave
master_sword_grave.description: A narrow stair beneath the old headstone ends in a cold, close vault. Twin fires burn on either side of a worn stone plinth, scored where a far longer blade once lay, and words are cut deep into its edge: THE THIEF OF POWER TOOK WHAT SLEPT HERE. SEEK IT IN HIS LAIR. A lesser blade, the Magical Sword, rests there now for one with twelve hearts. The stair climbs back up to the graveyard.

letter_cave.name: The Hermit's Cave
letter_cave.description: This cave sits high in the northeastern rocks where few travellers think to look. Two small fires warm a dry floor, and a writing desk has been made from a flat slab of stone, its inkpot dry and a ribbon of royal blue wax beside it. Chalked on the wall in a neat hand is a single instruction: SHOW THIS TO THE OLD WOMAN. Whoever lives here keeps the place tidy and keeps to the old courtesies.

heart_ledge.name: Across the Narrow Water
heart_ledge.description: This rocky ledge lies just beyond a channel of water too wide to step and too narrow to bother swimming; a traveller with a stepladder can bridge it in a moment. Sheltered from the coast wind by a shoulder of rock, the ledge is littered with gull feathers and driftwood around the red glow of a Heart Container, a gift each traveller may claim only once. The way back is up over the rocks to the coast.

secret_return_tree.name: Hollow of the Old Tree
secret_return_tree.description: The burned bush opened onto a hollow beneath the roots of an enormous old tree. The walls are packed earth and root, and the light here is strange: it flickers in square, coloured blocks and seems to come from somewhere other than Hyrule. A soft electric hum fills the hollow, and the air carries a faint smell of dust, coins and arcade lights, as though a way home lay close by.

power_bracelet_alcove.name: Under the Armos Statue
power_bracelet_alcove.description: The statue that guarded this spot has been moved, and beneath it lies a shallow stone alcove cut square into the bedrock. Its walls bear faded carvings of a hand gripping a mountain and lifting it, and of great stones rolled aside. The space is just large enough to kneel in, and it was clearly made to keep one small thing safe for whoever dared touch the sentinel above.

take_any:L8.name: Grotto Beneath the Sands
take_any:L8.description: Sand has sifted down through the hole you blasted, and it lies in a pale fan across the floor below the broken rock, gritty underfoot. Beyond it the cave is small and warm, lit by a pair of fires burning low on blackened stones. Between them two offerings rest side by side on a scrap of red cloth, set out so that only one may be taken. A rubble-choked stair climbs back up to the dunes.

take_any:H5.name: Cellar Under the Lakeside Bush
take_any:H5.description: Drifting ash from the burned bush still settles on the damp steps of the stairwell, and the air smells of lake water and charred leaves. The chamber below is round and close, its walls beaded with moisture, warmed by twin fires set in shallow pits. On the floor between them two gifts wait an arm's length apart, a choice rather than a pair. Steps lead up to the shore.

take_any:M3.name: Heartglow Hollow
take_any:M3.description: The red glow seen through the cracks comes from in here, a slow pulse thrown across the walls by something lying on the floor. Shattered cliff stone litters the entrance where the bomb went off, and a cool lake draught still finds its way in. Two fires flank the back wall, and before them a pair of offerings lie on bare rock; the dust shows only one is ever carried off. The way out climbs up through the broken cliff.

take_any:P3.name: Sanctum Under the Lonely Isle
take_any:P3.description: Water drips from the ceiling of this low cave, and every drop that lands in the puddles by the entrance echoes the lap of the lake outside. No rubble or ash marks the way in; the only toll was the raft crossing, and wet footprints dry slowly on the stone. A pair of fires burn at the back, and between them two offerings lie on the floor, waiting for a single choice. Stairs lead up to the island.

hint:A8.name: The Whispering Hearth
hint:A8.description: This little cave at the back of the meadow is swept tidy, and a woven mat lies before the far wall where a visitor is meant to stand and pay. Flower petals blown in from outside collect in the corners. Two small fires crackle in iron dishes, and a cracked clay bowl between them holds the odd rupee left by earlier callers. Stone steps lead up into the meadow.

hint:F8.name: Sand-Floored Hermitage
hint:F8.description: Fine pale sand has blown in from the glade and drifted against the walls of this snug cave, deep enough to swallow your heels. The ceiling is low and smoke-stained, and a pair of fires burn in a ring of stones at the back, throwing long shadows that seem to point toward the graveyard far to the north. A walking stick has worn a groove in the floor near the fires. The way out is up the stairs into the glade.

hint:K2.name: The Cave Behind the Falls
hint:K2.description: The roar of the waterfall fills this cave, muffled only a little by the curtain of water across its mouth, and spray mists the first few yards of floor. Further in, the stone is dry and two fires burn in hollows cut into the rock. A flat stone before them is worn smooth and ringed with coin-sized scratches where payment is laid down. Wet steps climb back up behind the falls.

hint:M2.name: The Statue's Undercroft
hint:M2.description: Grit and broken stone from the Armos base sprinkle the steep stair down into this narrow chamber, and the scrape of the statue sliding aside still seems to hang in the air. The walls are bare carved rock, and twin fires burn in sconces at the far end. Leaves and bark shavings are tracked across the floor, as though whoever keeps this place has lately come from some old tree. Steps lead up to the ridge.

rupee:B6.name: The Root Burrow
rupee:B6.description: Roots from the old trees above poke through the ceiling of this burrow, hung with scraps of dried moss, and soot from the burned bush has blown down the steps. A pair of fires flicker beside a heap of leaves pressed into the shape of a large sleeper. A cracked clay pot by the wall holds only a few small coins, enough for a modest gift and no more. The stair leads up into the deep wood.

rupee:B8.name: Den Behind the Woodland Rock
rupee:B8.description: Chunks of broken rock lie where the bomb tore open the woodland wall, and past them the den opens into a cosy space that smells of pine smoke and wet fur. Two fires burn in a ring of stones, and a stout wooden spear leans against the wall with a flower tied to its shaft. A sack in the corner clinks with a respectable number of coins. A stair rises back to the woods.

rupee:C7.name: The Generous Hollow
rupee:C7.description: Below the ash of the burned bush lies a deep, dry hollow lined with oak leaves and smelling of acorns. Twin fires burn bright, as if whoever lives here likes company, and their light falls on a heavy iron-bound chest stuffed so full of rupees that the lid will not shut. A crude carving of a grinning snout decorates the wall. Earthen steps climb up into the old forest.

rupee:D2.name: Terrace Strongroom
rupee:D2.description: Bombed terrace rubble spills across the threshold, and the room past it is cut square into the mountain like a miner's store. The pair of fires here burn behind a low wall of stacked stones, sheltered from the draught. Rupees are piled in neat columns along a shelf, counted and recounted by some broad thumb, and a gnawed bone lies beside them. The way up leads back to the terraces.

rupee:G6.name: Reedbed Hideaway
rupee:G6.description: Cattail fluff and charred twigs from the burned bush have drifted down into this damp little hideaway, and the walls sweat with lake water. Two small fires keep the chill off, and a woven reed basket between them holds a handful of coins, the savings of someone who is generous but not rich. Muddy pawprints circle the basket. The stair climbs up to the lakeside bank.

rupee:H7.name: The Hoard Above the Start
rupee:H7.description: A breach in the rock wall, still edged with fresh rubble, lets daylight into a burrow that has plainly been lived in for years. A pair of fires are kept fed from a stack of kindling by the door, and a lopsided stool sits near them. Rupees are tucked into niches pecked into the wall, a few in each, as though savings were hidden in many places at once. The way out climbs up through the broken wall.

rupee:I3.name: Ashen Thicket Burrow
rupee:I3.description: Thick ash from the burned thicket bush lies on the top steps, and below it the burrow smells of smoke old and new. Two fires burn in the middle of the floor, their stones cracked by long use. A heap of straw forms a bed against one wall, and next to it a battered boot holds a sockful of rupees, more than pocket money but less than a fortune. Steps rise to the open grassland.

rupee:I5.name: Sandbar Strongbox
rupee:I5.description: Sand from the bar above trickles down the steps whenever someone walks overhead, and charred stems from the burned bush lie in the drift. The cave itself is snug and dry, warmed by twin fires, and a battered wooden strongbox sits open between them, its lid propped on a stick and its inside glittering with coins. Broad clawed footprints lead to it and away again. Stairs climb back to the sand bar.

rupee:L6.name: Glade Keeper's Den
rupee:L6.description: Beneath the burned bush a short stair drops into a cramped den that smells of roasting meat and charcoal. The two fires here are banked low to save fuel, and a spit hangs empty over one of them. A single small pouch of coins rests on a flat rock, tied with a bit of blue hide; its owner gives a little and keeps a little. The stair leads back up to the glade.

rupee:L7.name: Treasury of the Shaded Grove
rupee:L7.description: Only the ash blown down from the burned grove bush spoils this treasury, for the rest is kept with surprising care. Moss has been laid on the floor like a carpet, twin fires burn in matched stone bowls, and rupees lie heaped against the back wall in a glittering bank deep enough to wade in. A bone comb and a polished shield hang on pegs. Moss-covered steps rise to the grove.

rupee:N3.name: Pebble-Strewn Coin Cellar
rupee:N3.description: Lake pebbles and broken rock from the bombed shore wall crunch underfoot at the entrance, and a damp breeze off the water follows you in. The cellar is low, with two fires burning near the back. Coins sit in a cracked jug, which explains the chinking heard outside whenever the wind gusts, and a moth-eaten blanket hangs over a peg. Stairs climb back up to the north shore.

rupee:N4.name: Vault Beneath the Stone Soldier
rupee:N4.description: Directly under the shoved-aside statue a cramped vault has been dug into the earth, its ceiling shored with planks that still bear the marks of the Armos sliding over them. Two fires burn in clay pots, and a stack of rupees stands on an upturned shield, tall enough to topple. Stone dust powders everything. The way out is up the stair, past the statue's empty plinth.

rupee:O5.name: Den Under the Sentinels
rupee:O5.description: Moss torn from the statue's base hangs over the top of the stair, and a smell of earth and cold stone fills the den below. It is small and plain, lit by a pair of fires on a hearth of flat river stones. A wooden bowl on the floor holds a few coins, a modest gift from a host with little to spare, and a carved wooden knight stands on the hearth as if for company. Steps climb back to the grove.

rupee:P1.name: The Crag's Secret Fortune
rupee:P1.description: Behind the small mouth in the crag, the cave widens into a surprisingly grand chamber lit by two tall fires. Rupees cover the floor along the back wall in drifts, and more are wedged in every crack of the rock, as if the owner ran out of places to put them. Snapped spear shafts serve as firewood, and the high wind off the eastern wilds follows you in. A short flight of steps leads up to the crag.

shop:C2.name: The Hammer-Ringing Store
shop:C2.description: Bits of shattered bluff lie inside the doorway where the bomb opened it, and an anvil scarred by long use stands against the wall, explaining the ringing heard outside. Two fires light a plank counter with three goods laid out: a Magical Shield marked 90, a lump of meaty bait marked 100, and a Recovery Heart marked 10, each price daubed in red paint. The way out climbs up past the rubble.

shop:E4.name: Under the Middle Sentinel
